title: Trappous

inlines.v: TRAP'POUS, adjective [from trap, in geology. It ought to be trappy.] Pertaining to trap; resembling trap, or partaking of its form or qualities. TRAP'-STICK, noun A stick with which boys drive a wooden ball; hence, a slender leg.
